blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-ops-2 (A dropped webhook is only logged at debug level, in free text, without the HTTP status) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Space the attempts with an exponential backoff and jitter (for example 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s), or hand failed deliveries to a delayed retry queue so the payment event listener is not held while waiting. The retries are bounded and the operation is deduplicated by `x-event-id`, so only the spacing is missing.
findings.title: Webhook retries fire back to back, with no backoff

findings.recommendation: Use the project's structured `logger` (as `src/events.ts` does) instead of `console.debug`: log each failed attempt with fields (`eventId`, `attempt`, `status` of a non-ok response or the error), and log the final drop at `error` level with `eventId`, the merchant or payment id, the last status and the error, so a dropped delivery is visible and alertable. The URL may carry a merchant token: do not log it whole.
findings.title: A dropped webhook is only logged at debug level, in free text, without the HTTP status
